lines.en: label utafirsthall:
scene utahall1
: Hey! What are you up to, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿！你在忙什么呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : Come to hang out with one of your six million girlfriends?
lines.zh: : 是来找你那六百万个女朋友里的哪一个玩吗？

lines.en: : All of them at once, actually. And what better place to do that than the dorms?
lines.zh: : 其实是要同时找她们所有人。而且还有什么地方比宿舍更适合干这个？

lines.en: : Hmmm...School, if you can be sneaky enough.
lines.zh: : 嗯……学校吧，只要你够偷偷摸摸。

lines.en: : That way, you could even rope some of the other classes into it. You can thank me later for the brilliant idea.
lines.zh: : 那样的话，你甚至能把其他班的人也拉进来。这个绝妙的点子你就留着以后谢我吧。

lines.en: : I might just have to do that.
lines.zh: : 我说不定真会那么做。

lines.en: : What are {i}you{/i} up to, Uta?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}在忙什么，Uta？

lines.en: : Me? Was just stopping for a quick drink of water on my way out to do some exploring.
lines.zh: : 我？我出来探险的路上，顺便停下来喝口水。

lines.en: : Right. You’re still getting acquainted with the area, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 对。你还在熟悉这一带，是吧？

lines.en: : Slowly but surely. It’s not as confusing as the area I was living in before this.
lines.zh: : 慢慢来，总会熟的。这儿没我以前住的那片地方那么让人摸不着头脑。

lines.en: : Over there, since the[school] was {i}in{/i} the actual city part, we didn’t get those cool stretches of nothingness like you have over here.
lines.zh: : 在那边，因为[school]{i}就在{/i}真正的市区里，我们没有你们这儿那种很酷的、什么都没有的空旷地带。

lines.en: : Reminds me a lot of Nara but with less wildlife and more...tamed life.
lines.zh: : 让我想起很多奈良的样子，只是野生动物少了些，多了些……被驯化的生命。

lines.en: : Is that a good or bad thing? I don’t think I’ve really asked you how you feel about this place other than the class itself.
lines.zh: : 那是好事还是坏事？除了对班级本身的感受，我好像从没真正问过你对这地方的感觉。

lines.en: scene utahall2
: It’s not...bad?
lines.zh: : 不……算不上坏？

lines.en: : Like yeah the class is awesome and I’m glad to finally have a teacher who doesn’t creep me out-
lines.zh: : 就是说，班级很棒，我也很高兴终于有个不会让我觉得恶心的老师——

lines.en: : Wait, what? Your other teachers creeped you out but I somehow don’t?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？你以前的老师都让你觉得恶心，而我居然不会？

lines.en: scene utahall1
: Oh totally. The fact that you’re so up front about how interested you are in [younger_girls] is actually weirdly comforting in a way.
lines.zh: : 百分之百不会。事实上，你对[younger_girls]有多感兴趣这件事表现得那么坦荡，反而有种诡异的让人安心。

lines.en: : It’s like, “Oh, nothing this guy does will surprise me.”
lines.zh: : 就像是，“哦，这家伙做什么都不会让我意外了。”

lines.en: : My other teachers have all been like, the secret kind of perverts who just stare at everybody from behind their desks and daydream instead of actually acting on anything.
lines.zh: : 我以前的老师全都是那种闷骚型的变态，只会躲在讲台后面盯着每个人看、做白日梦，从来不会真的动手。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that’s just how people are supposed to act, especially in public settings.
lines.zh: : 我敢说那才是人该有的样子，尤其是在公共场合。

lines.en: scene utahall2
: Probably. You’ve been fun so far, though.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过到目前为止，你挺有意思的。

lines.en: : As far as Kumon-mi itself goes, it’s not what I’d call my ideal place to live...but it’s not like I’m dying to get out just yet.
lines.zh: : 至于 Kumon-mi 本身，它算不上我理想中的居住地……可我也没到急着想逃走的地步。

lines.en: : What would your ideal place to live be, then?
lines.zh: : 那你理想中的居住地是什么样的？

lines.en: scene utahall3
: Well, even though it can get kind of boring over there at times, I think I {i}do{/i} prefer the country overall.
lines.zh: : 嗯，虽然那边有时候挺无聊的，不过我{i}确实{/i}整体上更喜欢乡下。

lines.en: : Places like this kinda lose their luster once you realize you can just do anything you want whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 像这样的地方，一旦你意识到自己可以随时随刻想干什么就干什么，它就失去光泽了。

lines.en: : It turns stuff I always viewed as super-special outings into another way of life.
lines.zh: : 它把我以前视为超级特别的出行，变成了另一种日常。

lines.en: scene utahall4
: But, it’s definitely easier finding work over here. Not a lot of maid cafes where I’m from.
lines.zh: : 不过，在这儿找工作确实容易多了。我老家可没那么多女仆咖啡厅。

lines.en: : And also not a lot of teachers willing to just let us girls teach ourselves. So, thanks!
lines.zh: : 而且也没那么多老师愿意干脆让我们这些女孩自学。所以，谢了！

lines.en: Interesting.
lines.zh: 有意思。

lines.en: I don’t think I’d particularly enjoy living in the country.
lines.zh: 我觉得自己不会特别喜欢住在乡下。

lines.en: But it’s not like Uta and I need to agree on everything in order to become better acquainted.
lines.zh: : 可我和 Uta 也不需要事事意见一致，才能变得更熟。

lines.en: I understand why she’d want to be somewhere closer to what she’s grown used to over the course of her life.
lines.zh: 我理解她为什么会想待在一个更接近她从小到大习惯的地方。

lines.en: Thankfully, I have the advantage (Or disadvantage, depending on how you look at it) of not remembering anything about my childhood-
lines.zh: : 幸运的是，我有个优势（或者说劣势，看你怎么看）——我对自己的童年一点都不记得——

lines.en: So somewhere like Kumon-mi is perfect for me.
lines.zh: : 所以像 Kumon-mi 这样的地方对我来说正合适。

lines.en: : No need to thank me for being bad at my job. I do that willingly.
lines.zh: : 不用谢我把工作干得这么烂。我是心甘情愿的。

lines.en: scene utahall5
: Hey! Don’t call yourself bad!
lines.zh: : 嘿！别说自己差劲！

lines.en: : I’m tryin’ to be serious here, Sensei. I think you’re great.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的，Sensei。我觉得你很棒。

lines.en: : Even Io has started feeling at home here and I don’t think she even looks at the bathhouse that way.
lines.zh: : 连 Io 都开始在这儿有家的感觉了，我觉得她现在看那间澡堂的眼神都不一样了。

lines.en: scene utahall1
: Plus, I think it’s cool that you’re allowed to come to the dorms and talk to us.
lines.zh: : 还有，我觉得你能来宿舍跟我们聊天这件事很酷。

lines.en: : I feel more inclined to learn if I’m closer to whoever’s teaching me.
lines.zh: : 离教我的人越近，我就越想学。

lines.en: : Is that code for “Let’s get even closer, Sensei?”
lines.zh: : 那是“我们再靠近一点吧，Sensei？”的暗号吗？

lines.en: scene utahall6
: Ohohoh~ Turnin’ the moves on even though I’m wearing three layers of clothes and a hat that smiles back?
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵~尽管我穿着三层衣服、还戴着一顶会冲你笑的帽子，你也要开始撩我？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have it any other way.
lines.zh: : 换别的我还不要呢。

lines.en: scene utahall7
: Thank you, Sensei. But as much as I appreciate your advances and unearthly desire to get it on with a girl under five-feet tall, I must once again decline.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei。不过尽管我很感激你的追求，以及你想跟一个不到五英尺高的女孩干那件事的那种超凡脱俗的欲望，我还是得再一次拒绝。

lines.en: : It would take far too long to remove all of these clothes and I do not want to get dressed again before embarking on my late-night journey to wherever the cold wind takes me.
lines.zh: : 把这些衣服全脱掉要花太久时间，而且我可不想在踏上这趟随冷风而行的深夜旅程之前，还得再穿一遍。

lines.en: : I can remove them for you. I don’t mind at all.
lines.zh: : 我可以帮你脱。我一点都不介意。

lines.en: : But then what would poor Io do? She’s still in the room.
lines.zh: : 那可怜的 Io 怎么办？她还在屋里呢。

lines.en: : Watch?
lines.zh: : 看着？

lines.en: scene utahall8
: You want to get freaky with me while my friend watches?!
lines.zh: : 你想在我朋友看着的时候跟我干坏事？！

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 算是吧，对。

lines.en: : But what if we both make really weird faces in the heat of the moment and she laughs at us?
lines.zh: : 可要是我们在情热时刻都露出很奇怪的表情，被她笑话怎么办？

lines.en: : Would you be able to keep it up if that happened?
lines.zh: : 要是那样，你还硬得下去吗？

lines.en: : I think I’d be a little too distracted by...what else is going on.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我会被……正在发生的其他事情分心得太厉害。

lines.en: : If someone ever made fun of me during a time like that, I’d stop like, immediately.
lines.zh: : 如果有人在那时候取笑我，我会立刻就停下来。

lines.en: : And then it would be really awkward because, like, I’d have to put all of these layers back on while they just laugh.
lines.zh: 然后就会非常尴尬，因为，呃，我得把所有那些层衣服再穿回去，而她们就在旁边笑。

lines.en: : And so I will never have sex for the rest of forever. It's simply not safe.
lines.zh: : 所以我有生之年都不会做爱了。那根本不安全。

lines.en: : You’re going to run out of excuses one day. And when that day comes-
lines.zh: : 你总有一天会找不出借口的。而等到那一天——

lines.en: scene utahall9
: Yes. When that day comes, I am ready to join the ever-growing list of names in my soon-to-be best selling novel, Sensei’s Secret Sex Journal.
lines.zh: : 对。等到那一天，我已经准备好加入我那本即将畅销的小说里那份不断变长的名单了——《Sensei 的秘密性爱日记》。

lines.en: : Finally, a book I actually want to read.
lines.zh: : 终于有一本我真的想读的书了。

lines.en: scene utahall8
: Are you really so self-absorbed that you’d read an entire book about yourself? Sensei, you’re better than this.
lines.zh: : 你真自恋到会读一整本关于你自己的书吗？Sensei，你不至于这样吧。

lines.en: : I’m really not, Uta. You just don’t realize it yet.
lines.zh: : 我真的至于，Uta。你只是还没意识到而已。

lines.en: scene utahall9
: Ah. Well then I apologize.
lines.zh: : 啊。那我道歉。

lines.en: : I shall pay closer attention to how much I am supposed to dislike you and will ignore the wonderful chemistry we have begun to form with each other.
lines.zh: : 我会更用心地注意自己该有多讨厌你，并且无视我们之间已经开始形成的那种美妙的化学反应。

lines.en: : I am sorry things had to end like this.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉事情只能这样收场。

lines.en: : I understand, Sensei. Things {i}needed{/i} to happen this way before they became too serious and one of us wound up with a broken heart.
lines.zh: : 我理解，Sensei。事情{i}必须{/i}这样发展，否则就会变得太认真，然后我们中有一个会心碎。

lines.en: : Probably me because I get attached too easily and would never leave you since I’m so nice.
lines.zh: : 大概会是我，因为我太容易动感情，而且我人太好了，永远不会离开你。

lines.en: : I’ve changed my mind. I love you.
lines.zh: : 我改主意了。我爱你。

lines.en: scene utahall10
: I remember...when I loved you...
lines.zh: : 我记得……我爱过你的时候……

lines.en: : It feels so long ago now...
lines.zh: : 感觉已经是很久以前的事了……

lines.en: : Goodbye...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 再见了……Sensei……

lines.en: scene utahall11
Uta smiles and walks right past me, closing her eyes and sighing to herself as she forever disappears from my life.
lines.zh: Uta 微笑着从我身边走过，闭上眼睛，自顾自地叹了口气，从此永远地消失在我的人生里。

lines.en: The days we shared with one another were brief, but they will echo in the back of my mind for as long as I live.
lines.zh: 我们共度的那些日子很短暂，但它们会在我脑海深处回响，直到我死去的那一天。

lines.en: scene black
I will never forget you, Uta Ushibori.
lines.zh: 我永远不会忘记你，Uta Ushibori。

lines.en: May you find happiness wherever the cold wind takes you.
lines.zh: 愿你在冷风带你去的任何地方找到幸福。

$ uta_love += 1
{i}Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}
